# Mushafuk — translations

> Quran translations and translated tafsirs at https://t.mushafuk.online. Part of Mushafuk (https://mushafuk.online). Free, no ads.

This host publishes translations of the meanings of the Quran and some translated tafsirs, as static HTML. A few books are on the sister host https://t1.mushafuk.online/; those are linked from this catalogue and are marked below.

## Start here

- [Catalogue on this host](https://t.mushafuk.online/)
- [Main translation catalogue](https://mushafuk.online/translations/)
- [More books (t1)](https://t1.mushafuk.online/)
- [Madinah mushaf](https://mushafuk.online/)
- [Translated tafsirs index](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/)
- [Sources](https://t.mushafuk.online/sources.html)
- [FAQ](https://t.mushafuk.online/faq.html)

## Translated tafsirs on this host

al-Mukhtasar: [Assamese](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/as/), [Azerbaijani](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/az/), [Bosnian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/bs/), [English](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/en/), [Spanish](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/es/), [Fulfulde](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ff/), [French](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/fr/), [Hindi](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/hi/), [Italian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/it/), [Japanese](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ja/), [Khmer](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/km/), [Kurdish](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ku/), [Kyrgyz](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ky/), [Malayalam](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ml/), [Pashto](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ps/), [Russian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ru/), [Sinhala](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/si/), [Serbian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/sr/), [Tamil](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ta/), [Telugu](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/te/), [Thai](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/th/), [Tagalog](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/tl/), [Turkish](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/tr/), [Uyghur](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/ug/), [Uzbek](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/uz/), [Vietnamese](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/vi/), [Chinese](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/mukhtasar/zh/).

al-Sa'di: [Russian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/saadi/ru/), [Albanian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/saadi/sq/), [Turkish](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/saadi/tr/).

Ibn Kathir: [English](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/ibnkathir/en/), [Russian](https://t.mushafuk.online/tafsir/tercume/ibnkathir/ru/).

Other language editions of those tafsirs are on https://t1.mushafuk.online/.

## Languages

This host covers many interface and translation languages, listed in the catalogue above. The Arabic mushaf itself is on https://mushafuk.online/.
